features: Note: The universal USB dongle is stored inside the keyboard’s battery compartment. Remove the battery cover and take out the USB receiver before first use to enable instant pairing.
(Cute Aesthetics for Your Space): Turn your boring desk into a place you enjoy working on. Our wireless FKBRI05 keyboard and mouse will improve overall feel so you can work happily.
(A Duo Ready for Any Task): The bubble keyboard features 104 rounded keys and 18 shortcut keys while the mouse has a familiar 3 button configuration to tackle your workload.
(Simple Plug and Play): Begin typing on the cute keyboard and mouse combo instantly. Just plug in the USB dongle. **Batteries are not included
(Easy Wireless Connectivity): Enjoy a wireless connection with a range of 30ft. A single 2.4G USB dongle is used to pair the typewriter keyboard mouse combo to your computer.
